author:
  - name: "Dan Olner"
format: 
  html:
    output-file: "Yorkshire_n_Humber_sector_catalogue_November2025"
    fig-width: 8
    fig-height: 8
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
fig-responsive: false
collapse: false
navbar: false
sidebar: false
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)#for geo stuff
library(tmap)#for mapping
library(zoo)#for making smoothed moving averages
library(patchwork)#combine ggplots easily
library(plotly)#For interactive plots
library(RColorBrewer)

source('../functions/misc_functions.R')
source('../functions/adhoc_functions.R')
#source('functions/misc_functions.R')
#source('functions/adhoc_functions.R')

options(scipen = 999)

# Data for this side of reality
itl3.ynh = readRDS('../local/data/itl3ynh.rds')
itl1.summedtoitl3SICs = readRDS('../local/data/itl1summedtoitl3SICs.rds')
bres.gva.2d = readRDS('../local/data/bresgva2d.rds')

ynhshortnames = readRDS('../local/data/ynhshortestnames.rds')

# For mapping
mask = readRDS('../local/ynhmask.rds')
itl3.ynh.zones = readRDS('../local/itl3ynh.rds')

sq = readRDS('../local/data/sq.rds')
hexsummary = readRDS('../local/hexsummary_for_dictionary.rds')

tmap_mode('plot')

```



## Manufacture of furniture; other manufacturing

### LQ gva/job plots


```{r, fig-Manufactureoffurnitureothermanufacturing}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 15

p = ynh_autoplots("Manufacture of furniture; other manufacturing")


# Text for adding to qgm document to plot the three combined plots
if(!is.null(p[[3]])){
  
  plottosave = p[[1]] / p[[2]] / p[[3]] + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(3, 12, 12))
  
} else {
  
  plottosave = p[[1]] / p[[2]] + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(3, 12))
  
}

plottosave




```


### Map: within-Y&H micro-LQ for 2024/25


![](../local/outputs/ch_hexmaps_fordictionary/Manufactureoffurnitureothermanufacturing.jpeg){width="700px"}
